title: Why AI Alignment Failure Is Structural: Learned Human Interaction Structures and AGI as an Endogenous Evolutionary Shock
reasoning: The paper contains an extensive theoretical discussion on the nature of morality and ethics in AI, specifically in Section 3 ('Why Training LLMs to Be Moral Is Conceptually Ill-Defined'). It explores moral pluralism, the historical contingency of moral systems, and mentions various religious/ethical traditions like Judeo-Christian, Confucian, Islamic, and Buddhist moralities.
